_ayuda: Respuestas para la lista de verificación de LG (self_evaluation_checklist_5.0.xlsx). 'TV' = Pass solo después de probarlo en un televisor LG real (npm run lg-checklist -- -Probado). Los comentarios van en inglés porque los leen los revisores de LG.

1: Installs and launches correctly (tested on a real LG TV in Developer Mode).
2: Loading screen, then the sign-in page or the Live TV main page. 1920x1080 layout, all elements inside the safe area.
3: Relaunch from the Launcher, Recent list and Search, and after power off/on and unplugging: the app starts again, keeps the session and plays video.
5: 1920x1080, 16:9 on every screen; no afterimages when changing screens.
6: Spanish texts without typos; long names are shortened with ellipsis; long lists and texts scroll.
7: Every selectable element shows a clear focus (idle / focused / selected states) with the arrow keys and the pointer.
8: No flicker when opening content or during playback.
9: Video always uses the full screen (16:9).
10: All UI buttons work as described in the UX scenario document.
11: There is no on-screen BACK UI button; the remote Back key is used on every screen (optional on webOS).
12: Account > 'Salir de la aplicación' (Exit) asks for confirmation and closes the app completely.
13: No lockup, latch-up or power off.
14: No abnormal termination, including network loss (message and automatic retry) with wired and wireless LAN.
15: Username, password and search fields use the LG virtual keyboard; text and numbers are entered correctly.
16: Entered characters are applied exactly as typed.
17: Text entered with the voice button of the LG keyboard is applied to the field.
18: No terms screen in the app. The privacy policy address is shown in Account.
19: No sign-up in the app. Accounts are created by the operator for its subscribers.
20: CASE2 (session kept): sign-in works; the session is kept after relaunching the app and after rebooting the TV. Test accounts in the UX scenario document.
21: Sign out: Account > 'Cambiar de perfil' (Switch profile), then the profile can be deleted.
22: Search by channel, movie or series name (accents and case ignored); clear and unclear words give results or a 'no results' message.
23: The service does not include adult content.
24: No in-app purchase. The service is a subscription contracted with the operator outside the app.
26: Standard remote: arrows, OK, Back, color keys, CH+/CH-, number keys and playback keys work as described; the app returns to its previous state.
27: Magic Remote supported: pointer, OK and wheel.
28: The pointer follows the Magic Remote and focuses the element under it.
29: Pointer over a button + OK selects it.
30: The wheel scrolls lists and grids.
31: The four arrow keys move the focus on every screen.
32: Red: add/remove favorite. Green: refresh messages. Shown with matching colors in the key hints.
34: The app supports both the standard remote and the Magic Remote.
35: The app supports both the standard remote and the Magic Remote.
36: HOME shows the webOS Home / Launcher; playback stops and resumes when returning.
37: BACK returns to the previous screen and finally to where the app was entered (exit confirmation or TV Home on webOS 23+).
38: EXIT closes the app and returns to Live TV.
39: Condition applies to NetCast 4.5 / webOS 1.0 remotes only.
40: Unsupported keys are ignored; in the full-screen live player the number keys select a channel.
41: The app is only in Spanish; there is no language setting.
42: Not a game: no background music or sound effects (only the audio of the video).
43: Live channels (MPEG-TS/HLS) and on-demand videos play correctly; streams are delivered by the operator. Tested with IPv4.
44: Video is always shown full screen (16:9); there is no screen mode switch.
45: Player (HTML5 video): OK/Play/Pause, Stop, Rewind/Fast Forward and Left/Right seek, Next/Previous; the same with remote keys and pointer. Audio and video in sync.
46: After a series episode ends it can be played again or the next episode can be started.
47: Live channels play in real time.
49: Movies and episodes offer 'Continuar' (resume) from the last position.
50: SD, HD and Full HD content delivered by the operator plays correctly (no UHD content).
51: H.264 video with AAC audio in MPEG-TS and HLS plays correctly.
53: After a factory reset the app installs, launches and plays content.

otherCheckPoints._nota: Condiciones que causan rechazo. 'Pass' = la app NO tiene ese problema.
1: Title is the operator's brand name (PTOVS TV).
3: PTOVS is the operator's own brand.
4: The seller is the operator; no reference to LG.
15: Not a multi-region app: service area Colombia, Spanish.
16: The app shows the operator's licensed TV channels and on-demand content.
42: Age rating set according to the operator's content.
